definitions.meaning: At no distant date, before long, soon

quotations.old_english: Ðú áfindst his mihte ungefyrn on ðé sylfum
Eallum folce ðæs swíðe ungefyrn (very soon after that) hé geswutelian wolde hwæs gehwá gelýfan sceolde

source_text: un-gefyrn; adv. At no distant date, before long, soon :-- Ðú áfindst his mihte ungefyrn on ðé sylfum, Homl. Skt. ii. 25, 153. Eallum folce ðæs swíðe ungefyrn (very soon after that) hé geswutelian wolde hwæs gehwá gelýfan sceolde, i. 23, 405. v. un-fyrn.
